title: User Streaks
description: For each user, count how many consecutive days they logged in.
solution:
WITH streaks AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    login_date,
    DATE(login_date, '-' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY login_date) || ' days') AS grp
  FROM logins
)
SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS streak_length
FROM streaks
GROUP BY user_id, grp
ORDER BY user_id, streak_length DESC;
